text:
Horse and rider are already two animals.
One plus one,
we say. And we think:
one apple plus one apple,
one glass plus one
glass,
always identical things.

What a change when
one plus one is a Puritan
plus a gamelan,

one jasmine plus one Arab,
a nun and a cliff,
a song and a
mask,
once more a garrison and a maiden,
someone’s hope
plus another’s dream.

From “Reduction of the Infinite,” 2002
